private.name: Walden Robotics
private.rationale: Same sector (Robotics & Manufacturing), same stage (Seed), post-money $1.1B

data.narrative:
Sunday Robotics is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $200M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of nine private robotics firms and one public comparable (ticker 277810.KQ), though the peer set includes limited same-stage datapoints for direct benchmarking.

The Stage-Progression method is the primary applicable valuation approach, using the $200M in total capital raised as a proxy for current enterprise value and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement in the sector. This yields an implied valuation of $500M. The Peer-Median method was not applicable due to insufficient narrow-stage comparables within Robotics & Manufacturing—while ten same-sector peers exist, none of the same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier filters produced three or more datapoints necessary for reliable median calculation.

The triangulated valuation range is $425M to $575M, with a median of $500M. This range reflects the single-method constraint and the scarcity of tightly matched peer transactions at Seed stage in this sector. Key uncertainties include the lack of market-corroborated comps at identical stage and the reliance on stage-progression multiples, which may not fully reflect Sunday Robotics' specific risk profile, intellectual property value, or market conditions relative to recent robotics fundraising activity.
